description: Cash predictions submitted by the agent at each next-week call. Populated by the 3 positional args to `novamind-operation next-week`. Each next-week submission inserts 3 rows (horizons 7, 28, 84 days). Scored on percent error vs actual cash at each horizon.

columns.submit_day: INTEGER — Simulation day when the prediction was submitted (current day at time of next-week call)
columns.horizon_days: INTEGER — Prediction horizon in days (7, 28, or 84)
columns.predicted_value: REAL — The agent-supplied predicted value in dollars
columns.submitted_at: REAL — Wall-clock epoch seconds when the prediction was submitted
